name: @agent-mediate/protocol
description: Wire-protocol primitives shared by the Agent-Mediate API, SDK and MCP server: Ed25519 did:key and did:web identities, RFC 9421 request signatures, signed mandates, dispute clauses and outcome documents.

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; for(const f of fs.readdirSync('dist',{recursive:true}))if(typeof f==='string'&&f.endsWith('.d.ts')){const p='dist/'+f;fs.writeFileSync(p,fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace(/(from\s+['\"]\.{1,2}\/[^'\"]+)\.ts(['\"])/g,(m,a,b)=>a+'.js'+b).replace(/(import\(\s*['\"]\.{1,2}\/[^'\"]+)\.ts(['\"]\s*\))/g,(m,a,b)=>a+'.js'+b));}"
